    Convert a vector of concept ids into concept set items

    conceptIdsToItems.Rd

    Fetches concept metadata for each id and wraps it in the concept set item shape (concept + isExcluded + includeDescendants + includeMapped) expected by the WebApi "optimize" endpoint.

    Usage

    conceptIdsToItems(
  conceptIds,
  webApiUrl,
  vocabularySourceKey = NULL,
  isExcluded = FALSE,
  includeDescendants = TRUE,
  includeMapped = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    conceptIds

    integer vector of concept ids

    webApiUrl

    Atlas WebApi base URL

    vocabularySourceKey

    vocabulary source key; defaults to the WebApi's priority vocabulary

    isExcluded, includeDescendants, includeMapped

    flag values applied to every item

    Value

    a plain list of concept set items
